user.title: MyItalgas
user.description: Sign in with the credentials of the MyItalgas customer portal (clienti.italgas.it).

data_description.username: The username you use on clienti.italgas.it.
data_description.password: The password you use on clienti.italgas.it.

pdr.title: Choose the supply
pdr.description: Your MyItalgas profile has more than one supply point. Choose the one to add; you can add the others later by adding the integration again.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to MyItalgas again
reauth_confirm.description: The MyItalgas portal rejected the saved credentials for PDR {pdr}. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: The MyItalgas portal cannot be reached. Try again later.
error.portal_error: The MyItalgas portal returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
error.no_pdr: No supply is associated with this MyItalgas profile. Add it in the PdR section of the portal first.
error.pdr_missing: The supply {pdr} is not associated with this MyItalgas profile.

abort.already_configured: All the supplies of this profile are already configured.

data_description.intervallo_ore: How often to check the portal for new readings. Smart meters are read about once a month: 12 hours is plenty.
data_description.coefficiente: Coefficient C shown on your gas bill, used to convert cubic meters into standard cubic meters (Smc).
data_description.prezzo: Optional. Average price per standard cubic meter, all costs included (see your bill). If set, an estimated cost statistic is created for the Energy dashboard; the same price is applied to the whole history. 0 = disabled.

auth_failed.message: The MyItalgas portal rejected the credentials.

pdr_not_found.message: The supply {pdr} is no longer associated with the MyItalgas profile.
